build_wan_i2v_pipeline: build a Wan image-to-video diffusion pipeline with DMD denoising stages and LoRA adapter support
create_pipeline_stages: create pipeline stages for image-to-video diffusion with DMD denoising and standard TI2V stages
initialize_pipeline: initialize the Wan pipeline with a FlowMatchEuler discrete scheduler configured from server args
add_lora_adapter: add a LoRA adapter to the Wan pipeline transformer for conditional video generation
run_pipeline_forward: run the Wan pipeline forward pass to generate video frames from an input image and text prompt
